scope: Americas(-170..-30longitude,-60..85latitude) plus northern/tropical Pacific(>=120 or <=-140longitude,-25..70latitude), and western Island Asia(95..120longitude,-12..25latitude), through1934CE. Geography filter is an editorial bounding envelope; no claim of exhaustive historical detection.
method: Deduplicate exact catalog IDs; reject conflicting duplicates. Preserve original rows. Historical negative BCE years become astronomical year+1 (1 BCE = 0); no historical year zero is accepted. Source year <=1934; same geographic envelope as existing hazards. No inferred date intervals or settlement impacts.
limitations: Catalog epicenter only, not a shaking footprint or affected settlement. Historical dates, locations and magnitudes can be uncertain; missing uncertainty fields do not establish precision. Original source fields and publication status are retained. This selective significant-event catalog is not an exhaustive earthquake history; completeness varies by region and period. Source casualty or damage fields describe the catalog event and are not assigned to atlas sites. No settlement impact is inferred.
